lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are organized into approximately eight identifiable horizontal rows along the mid-to-posterior flank. Centroid density is highest in the region immediately posterior to the pectoral fin, with spot diameters increasing toward the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity (light gray) intersect the horizontal rows of spots at near-perpendicular angles, forming a rectilinear grid where most high-intensity blobs are positioned at or near the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible. Each is characterized by a high-intensity luminance gradient along the dorsal margin and a corresponding high-contrast shadow on the ventral margin, running parallel to the longitudinal axis from the gill region to the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin displays a sparse distribution of roughly 12 visible high-luminance blobs. These are arranged in semi-vertical columns that align with the trajectory of the vertical flank stripes extending into the fin's macro-mask.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-contrast, elongated auxiliary organism is visible trailing from the ventral region adjacent to the posterior edge of the pectoral fin.
